verdict.rationale: First-party docs refer to a 1Password desktop app: the CLI integrates with it using Touch ID or Windows Hello, Git commit signing is configured from it, and export works from the apps. One-time password storage is documented, and community users say the desktop apps work well, though some criticize them as Electron rather than native. Missing for 10: a first-party doc that describes the desktop app's features and platforms, and explicit evidence that OTP codes are shown and copied in the desktop app rather than inferred from generic OTP storage.

support.subject: As a power user, a first-class desktop app gives me codes and vault access on my computer, not just on mobile
